messages:
Priya S: Quick thread to capture the triage items from today's DR retro. We saw the same three-signal cluster again (route asymmetry -> missed backup -> cold-cache storms). Need clear owners, and a short checklist we can run during the next game day.
Marcus R: I'll take route asymmetry. Plan: run a tie-break sweep of region-pair hashes and LB weight drift logs. ETA: Mon EOD.
Ivy C: I'll take backups ownership. Action: confirm retention policy, validate last 7 snapshots for us-west and eu-central, and add an alert for >1 failed cycle. ETA: Tue morning.
Ken T: Happy to own cold-cache mitigation. Proposal: add per-shard TTL metrics and a soft-warm-pop warming job. I'll prototype a throttled prefill for top-100 prefixes. ETA: Wed.
Priya S: Thanks. Can we also schedule a mini-game-day dry-run for cold restore in eu-central? We only validated warm standby historically.
Marcus R: I can coordinate a 2-hr slot. Prefer Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC (low traffic). Will need infra support for BGP drain and LB weight override.
Ivy C: For snapshots: discovered a tiny window where the backup lambda times out when job overlaps with heavy compaction. I'll add a jitter and increase timeout to 15m. Also will add a probe that checks manifest consistency.
Ken T: For the prefill job I'll add a kill-switch and a dashboard panel showing prefill throughput and error rate. Also will include a safe-rate limiter.
Priya S: Small runbook snippet draft for the dry-run pre-checks (put into the thread so we can iterate):
```
- confirm latest snapshot timestamp >= 6h and validate checksum
- ensure isolated test VPC is provisioned
- snapshot -> restore to test-db instance
- run `consistency_check --fast` and parse failures
- disable external traffic; run LB weight override script: `scripts/force-weights --region eu-central --weight 0`
- execute gradual traffic shift 0 -> 25 -> 50
- monitor 5xx, tail logs for KV eviction surge
- rollback: `scripts/revert-weights` and tombstone test instance
```
Marcus R: small note: we'll need a perms ticket for me to change LB weights in eu-central. Filing now.
Ivy C: Also opening a pager rule to fire when snapshot error rate > 1% over 2 cycles. Pager to infra-oncall + backups team.
oncall-bot: Heads up: DR-dryrun slot pending confirmation 60 days before test window. Please update the action tracker.
Priya S: Timeline summary for the tracker: Marcus (route asymmetry) 3 Mon EOD; Ivy (snapshots + alerts) 3 Tue AM; Ken (cold-cache prefill + dashboards) 3 Wed; Dry-run coordination Marcus+Priya 3 Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Reviewers: @Ivy C for backup steps, @Priya S for runbook signoff.
Marcus R: Blocking: need infra perms + a maintenance window. Filing infra request now.
Ken T: I'll draft the dashboard panels and link the Grafana folder here when ready.
Priya S: Good. One more ask: let's add a lightweight periodic retro (15 min) every 2 weeks to look for repeat combos of signals so we can consolidate mitigations. I'll propose a recurring invite.
Ivy C: +1
Marcus R: +1
Ken T: +1. Adding a short doc with mitigation options (autosync LB job, enforce snapshot retention, warming job) and will attach it to the tracker.
Priya S: Thanks everyone. I'll update the central tracker after this thread and tag owners. :thumbsup:
